mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect a crisp 42 degrees with clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and a waxing crescent moon. Also, keep your eyes on the skies tonight at 6:32 PM for a three-minute ISS flyover, rising over Mount Horeb and heading toward Madison near Home Depot, reaching halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona has released general election notices for November 2026, and the Plan Commission will review development projects for the Liberty Business Park, including site plans for Sub-Zero, at their upcoming meeting on December 7.

There is plenty to do, including the Dane County Farmers Market today, live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's today, the music of John Denver at the high school tomorrow, and trivia nights scheduled for next Tuesday at Hop Haus and other local spots.
In a notable weekly incident on October 25, officers arrested a man for O W I after he was discovered passed out in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. The store is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10:30 PM tonight.
